title: VRM Add-on for Blender
summary: Imports and exports VRM 0.x and 1.0 humanoid avatars (.vrm): humanoid bone mapping, metadata, expressions, spring bones and MToon materials.
useWhen: The game or its tools use VRM avatars (VRoid-style characters): read .vrm files into Blender to fix or convert them to .glb, or turn a rigged humanoid into a .vrm.
avoidWhen: Godot only needs a skinned .glb: export glTF directly; VRM adds nothing unless something expects .vrm files.
